title: Companion marketplace manifest (ws-companion-marketplace/v1)
description: The marketplace.json at the root of a pack source. Readers ignore fields they do not know, so every object here stays open. One bad entry does not hide the other entries of the list; the dashboard reports it beside that entry.

schema.description: The format marker. Any other value is refused.

packs.description: The listed packs. An id may be listed only once.

httpsUrl.description: An absolute https URL without credentials, spaces or control characters.

entry.description: One listed pack. It is self-contained (path names a directory inside the same archive) or external (url and sha256 name a separate pack zip).

id.description: The pack ID. It must equal the id in the pack's own pack.json.

version.description: Shown to the user only. Updates are detected from the pack content, never from this string.

format.description: Optional renderer format of the pack (2d or vrm).

vroidSourceUrl.description: Optional https URL linking to the original character model source.

path.description: A clean relative directory inside the archive that holds pack.json, such as packs/sample-a. No leading slash, drive letter, backslash, or .. segment.

url.description: An https URL of a zip that holds one pack, with pack.json at its root or in its single top-level folder.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the pack zip, as 64 lowercase hex characters. It is checked before the zip is opened.
